name: Verified answers
about: Answers checked against Microsoft Learn in November 2026. Use them to check a live answer, and as a dated fallback only when the Microsoft Learn connector is not available. The live page always wins.

answers.question: How do I share a skill?
steps: Open Customize, then the skill's detail page.
Select Share, choose Specific users in your organization and add their names.
Select Apply.
When you change the skill later, select Re-share so everyone gets the latest version.

answers.question: How do I run something on a schedule?
steps: Say what you want and when, for example: Draft the variance commentary on the 5th of every month.
Cowork sets up the schedule and asks you to approve it.
Manage it on the Automations page, where you can edit, pause, resume or delete it.
You can have up to 25 scheduled prompts.

answers.question: How do I start a task when an email arrives?
steps: Describe what to watch for and what to do, for example: When the ledger-locked email arrives, draft the commentary for my review.
Cowork shows a Set up trigger? card with when it runs, where it runs and what it does.
Check the permissions it needs, then select Set up.
By default it drafts and asks for your approval before anything is sent.

answers.question: How do I create a skill?
steps: Open Customize, then the Skills tab.
Select Add, then Create new.
Answer the questions about the name, description, category and instructions.
Confirm in chat. Cowork saves it to your skills folder, ready from your next conversation.

answers.question: How do I upload a plugin?
steps: Open Customize, then the Plugins tab.
Select Upload plugin and choose the plugin package, a .zip file.
In the Share dialog, choose Only you or Specific users in your organization.
Select Apply.

answers.question: How does an admin deploy a plugin?
steps: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, open Manage apps, then Upload custom app.
Select the ellipsis, then Add agent, and upload the .zip package.
Choose who can use it.
In Cowork, it appears under Plugins in the Discover section.
